title: Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference Guest Speech Review p06 Shengqu Games Qian Dijia MD Fabric and Unreal Interaction
description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

During this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game development and virtual creation. The presentations covered practical tips for designing game character clothing, from the collaborative growth between Marvelous Designer and its users to the shocking launch of new features in 2025, and specifically explained how Marvelous Designer interacts with Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual clothing.

Don't miss out on these fantastic insights!

Since then, our company has been focusing on high-end material models in 3D printing. ## Project Overview: High-End Material Models Next, I would like to introduce these models. First of all, I would like to introduce two models based on the needs of different projects and their performance: ### Geometry Cache The first model is the **Geometry Cache**. The Geometry Cache is a tool that can be used for high-end materials. For example, we have seen a lot of high-end materials such as steel shavings and other items that we often see in our MD projects. Examples include high-end materials used on windows or sculptures. In fact, I find that this MD has already made a decision when designing, and it is a very good model. It can be used for many other projects, including the Geometry Cache. The Geometry Cache is a great model for the production of high-end materials such as art and media, making it very beneficial for introducing new high-end materials to our projects. ### Time Simulation The second model is the **Time Simulation**. We can also use this kind of dynamic system to study the ROD. Additionally, we can use it in MDP to work with the ROD to simulate EVE. In the end, we can also utilize it in the game engine. ## Maximo Network Integration We can see that the **Maximo network** is familiar to everyone, especially with the current AI processes. This network allows us to prepare numerous animations that can be used to test materials in the MDP network or for performance animations. If we opt not to use this software, we can utilize the message reset function directly. The new versions 5.3 and 5.4.5 have significantly improved this reset function. ## Animation Transition Techniques We can see that the same human action and animation between Skyrim and the ROD we are going to use can be employed to change the work and check whether it matches the desired effects. Since today we are primarily discussing real activity, I am using Maximo's Converter as an example to explain this process. ### Action Performance in MDP In the new version of MDP, there is already a function that supports this type of action performance. The transition from the initial action from the hitbox or standby action to the t-box is pivotal. We have an animation where the transition needs to be controlled through the **Baitment Control Rig**. The initial point marks the start of our entire animation transition. We will move forward from 20 to 30 points. Since most actions in animation consist of 32 frames per second, we are effectively working within this transition range. ### Reference and Deletion After the Baitment control, we can see several references during this transition. These transition references are based on the performance of the initial force relative to our animation. If we delete these references, we can quickly create a transition animation. ## 2024 Enhancements and Features Once the animation is ready, we need to consider the newly released aliasing functionalities in 2024. Using the nanobot, we can directly download the interface and the required animation for hands, head, body, and legs. After downloading this with one click, it is highly effective. We actually used two worksheets for this: the first one is the worksheet for USD. ### USD and Physical Properties USD allows us to utilize the basic physics properties in MD to create new types of work. It is important to note that USD is not a traditional approach. In traditional NRA, we consider models for close calculations. For instance, if we have something attached to the body, like a bag or a decorative item, it only needs to be calculated by MD. This is crucial as physical calculations require significant CPU resources to integrate the human body model. ## Optimization Techniques The second task is to identify unnecessary details to enhance efficiency.
